Checkbox

Checkbox. A real input drives the drawn box through :checked. Class contract: .rse-choice.rse-checkbox.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Custom checkbox, filled purple with a checkmark when active.

<Checkbox label="Aceito os termos" checked={agree} onChange={e => setAgree(e.target.checked)} />

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
labelReact.ReactNode—

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, 'type'>, a ref and className.

CSS classes

Blocks
.rse-checkbox .rse-choice .rse-control-box .rse-control-input
Elements
.rse-choice__box .rse-choice__label .rse-choice__mark

Component tokens

Set any of these on :root or an ancestor to re-skin Checkbox without touching its CSS. Each defaults to a role token, so it follows the theme. Use a role or palette token as the new value, and keep its pairs in scripts/contrast-pairs.mjs passing.

TokenDefaultLightDarkContrast
--rse-choice-box-bg{rse.color.surface-card}#ffffff#24232f#ffffff
--rse-choice-box-border{rse.color.border-strong}#84806f#7a7890#000000
--rse-choice-checked{rse.color.primary}#6c62c4#8e82d8#4a3fa8
--rse-choice-label{rse.color.text-body}#454235#cfcdc6#1a1926
--rse-choice-mark{rse.color.text-on-primary}#ffffff#171622#ffffff
